ai_summary: Aurum PropTech Limited's 13th Annual General Meeting concluded with all proposed resolutions being passed, including the adoption of FY2026 financial statements and the re-appointment of a director. Material approvals included granting remuneration to Non-Executive Directors even in the absence or inadequacy of profits, varying the objects of a Rights Issue, and sanctioning material Related Party Transactions. The unspecified nature of the Rights Issue object variation and significant Related Party Transactions, alongside the director remuneration policy, are notable actions that warrant further investor scrutiny into the company's capital allocation strategy and governance.
